commits.author: Evgeny Vasilenkov
commits.message:
Merge pull request #515 from vaazhen/fix/crypto-audit-hardening

fix(crypto): close remaining E2EE audit holes

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
fix(crypto): close remaining audit holes in trust, self-whisper, and backup

Stop grouping device trust by server-supplied userId, delete the static self-whisper decoder, keep backups identity-only, and bind AAD to sender and target device ids so a malicious server cannot silently join a session.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
fix(crypto): close the audit holes around self-whisper, OTK, and identity

commits.author: Evgeny Vasilenkov
commits.message:
Merge pull request #513 from vaazhen/harden/reliability-no-mls

Harden delivery, group caps, and device revoke

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
fix(devices): keep revoke from being undone by the stolen client

A deactivated device kept its refresh family and JWT rebind turned it active again. Bind the session to the device, kill that family on revoke, and treat DEVICE_REVOKED as logout rather than missing enrollment.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.author: Evgeny Vasilenkov
commits.message:
Merge pull request #512 from vaazhen/harden/reliability-no-mls

fix(reliability): cap pairwise groups and make revoke durable

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
fix(reliability): cap pairwise groups and make revoke durable

Freeze this protocol generation: 32-member groups, 8 devices, revoke
closes that device's WebSocket and emits DEVICE_REVOKED. Wire Prometheus
alerts, default-deny NetworkPolicy, and a Postgres dump/restore drill.
No MLS, no claimed audit.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.author: Evgeny Vasilenkov
commits.message:
Merge pull request #511 from vaazhen/harden/review-correctness

fix(delivery): keep real outbox events and bound sync abuse

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
fix(delivery): keep real outbox events and bound sync abuse

Recurring chat keys were collapsing distinct updates, and request/chat
accept shared one idempotency key so the chat-list event never shipped.
Clamp sync, prekey, and lookup surfaces; stream attachments; fail closed
on call mediaKeys. Audit, S3, and TURN stay out of scope.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>

commits.message:
Merge pull request #505 from vaazhen/feat/calls-media-chat

feat(chat): encrypted media, video notes and 1:1 calls

commits.author: vaazhen
commits.message:
feat(chat): deliver encrypted media and 1:1 call signaling

Voice, video notes and photos now upload ciphertext instead of stuffing blob URLs or inline base64 into envelopes. Attachment inserts write object_key so Flyway V40 no longer 409s. Local calls use authenticated STOMP plus coturn; production stays gated until TURN exists.

Co-authored-by: Cursor <cursoragent@cursor.com>
